title: Trajectory preview, intro hints, and invulnerability fixes

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Ship trajectory preview now fades out immediately after you stop thrusting instead of lingering as visual noise.
Trajectory preview no longer gets stuck visible after intro overlay sequences.
Players are now correctly vulnerable once the calibration intro hands off to live play.

sections.heading: Changed
items: One of the intro hint messages has been updated.

title: Intro sequence, visual polish, and performance improvements

sections.heading: New
items: A beat-locked intro overlay now plays at the start of each run, fading in gameplay tips before revealing the world.
First-time players see a 'Latency calibrated' confirmation screen followed by three gameplay hints and a closing 'Become one with the Pulsar' line.
Returning players after 4+ hours see the full three-hint pilot's log; same-day re-entries get a lighter single-hint opener.
Hints rotate each session so the same three lines are not repeated back-to-back.
Pulsar now displays richer nebula, flare, glow, core, and pinprick visual effects.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Pulsar eclipse flare no longer incorrectly blooms when totality is zero.
Target lock hum now fades out quickly when the reticule leaves a target instead of lingering.

sections.heading: Tuning
items: Target lock animation and sound use a smooth sine swell instead of a sharp pop, keeping your ear on the song beat.
Lock fill animation and cue are now snapped to the song's beat grid for tighter audio-visual sync.
Lock proximity zone is tightened so drift-shot credit only triggers on near-direct overlap.
Canvas shadow blur removed globally, improving rendering performance across all game objects.

title: Laser Shot, new music tracks, and visual polish

sections.heading: New
items: New Laser Shot powerup lets you charge up a powerful beam and release it on the beat for massive damage.
Four new background music tracks added to the rotation: vaporwave, outer-wilds folk, dawn/crystal, and synthwave styles.
Bullets now flash when they cross your reticule on-beat, giving clear visual confirmation of on-beat hits.
A one-time hint appears the first time you complete a Drift Lock, explaining the x2 damage mechanic.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Asteroids spawning at screen edges no longer travel at shallow angles that caused visual glitches.
Gameplay clock now stays tightly synced to the music, reducing drift between the beat and audio.

sections.heading: Changed
items: First-wave asteroids now materialize in a ring around the player instead of appearing from fixed positions.
Reticule beat pulse is significantly stronger, making rhythm timing easier to read at a glance.
Kick drum and bass sounds updated for more presence and improved audio quality.
Background music tracks updated with improved audio quality across all styles.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Replays now correctly reproduce wave 1 layout when the tutorial or veteran pilot setting differs between the recorder and the viewer.
Replays now use the original player's control bindings, so recorded inputs map to the correct actions even if the viewer has rebound their keys.
Returning to the title screen after watching a replay no longer leaves the viewer stuck with the recorded pilot's key bindings.

title: Improved visuals, audio, and enemy behavior

sections.heading: New
items: Drift bonus popup now shows a '2× DAMAGE' subtitle the first time you pull off a Drift Shot in a run.
The starfield and background planets now share a coherent camera with subtle parallax and a slow roll as you progress.
The boss planetoid is now visually distinct with an oblong silhouette and updated eclipse corona effects.
Updated in-game music tracks with new orchestral cello and choir layers for later rounds.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Alien saucers now reliably cross the screen instead of clipping a corner and exiting from the same edge they entered.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Replay saving is now a checkbox preference in the score entry form instead of a one-time button.
Slow-motion effect is less extreme, making slow-mo sequences feel snappier.
Bassteroids are less durable, reducing the bullet budget required to clear them.

title: Replays, per-channel audio, and visual overhaul

sections.heading: New
items: Gameplay replays can now be saved and uploaded after posting a high score — watch your run from the leaderboard.
Leaderboard entries show a replay button when a recording is available.
Audio settings now have separate volume sliders for Base Pulse, Sound Effects, Music, and Vocals.
Rhythm latency calibration has moved into the Audio settings tab for easier access.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Background planets are now backlit: their bodies sit in deep shadow with a thin crescent rim-light on the pulsar-facing side, plus a corona flare during eclipses.
Planets now render in front of the pulsar disc and nebula, so they correctly occlude it when crossing.

sections.heading: Tuning
items: White bullet (super-boosted) combo threshold raised from 8 to 12 — harder to reach but the yellow halo tier now lasts longer.

title: Prong aiming improvements and Pilot's Log vocals option

sections.heading: New
items: Added a setting to disable Pilot's Log vocals while still unlocking log entries normally.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Prong shots now correctly show hover rings on both prong reticules, and drift-lock can trigger off either prong.
Aim disc tick lengths now render correctly on each individual prong reticule.

title: Aliens now arc and drift off-screen instead of wrapping

sections.heading: Changed
items: Aliens fly a curving, arcing path across the field instead of moving in straight lines.
Aliens no longer wrap around the screen edges — they drift off and disappear.
Alien engine drone sounds stop correctly when an alien leaves the screen.
Prong reticule now properly anchors the drift-shot bonus to the first prong angle.

title: Solid crystal gem drops and fragment changes

sections.heading: Changed
items: Solid crystals now use weighted probabilities for gem drops: 60% chance of 0 gems, 25% for 1, 10% for 2, and 5% for 3.
Destroying a large solid crystal now produces 2 fragments instead of 3.
The in-game bonus label has been renamed from "DRIFT BONUS" to "DRIFT SHOT".

title: Dev log button and aim disc visual improvements

sections.heading: New
items: A new "dev log" button in the overlay lets you open and close the latest dev log entry at any time.
An indicator dot appears on the dev log button when there is an unread entry.
The dev log panel can now be dismissed with the Escape key.

sections.heading: Fixed
items: Aim disc color now correctly matches your ship's trajectory chevron color.

title: Solid crystals, manta aliens, and stinger bullets

sections.heading: New
items: Solid crystal asteroids appear in waves — tougher than normal rocks, they shatter into fast fragments and drop collectible gems.
Alien ships now sport a sleek manta-ray silhouette with curved wings, cephalic horns, glowing structural ribs, and an animated whip tail.
Big aliens fire an 8-shot fan burst in a wide arc, then pause before the next volley.
Alien bullets now appear as slim stinger darts instead of round blobs.
The big alien's fire sound uses a sampled electric guitar.

sections.heading: Changed
items: Ship trajectory preview now shows directional chevrons instead of dots for clearer heading indication.
Aim disc rendering distinguishes between primary and secondary weapon slots.
Gold crystals shatter on ship contact with an updated sound effect.
